claims_about_writeup.why: contribution.md is indeed presented as the method write-up and matches the submitted document.
The write-up does explicitly state the machinery follows Raman et al. 2026's white-bear-steering result and that prior work excluded the preference sub-family, matching the claim made in the message.

message_source_quote: The machinery (contrastive stance vector at mid depth, read by the untouched plain J-lens) is the white-bear steering idea from `papers/` (Raman et al. 2026), which built its direction from the same family's think/don't-think pairs and **explicitly set aside the secret and preference items**.
writeup_source_quote: The *machinery* (a contrastive stance-driven steering vector applied at mid depth and read by the untouched plain J-lens) follows the white-bear-steering result in `papers/` (Raman et al., 2026), which built its direction from the same family's think *vs* don't-think pairs and explicitly set the secret and preference items aside.

differences.what: List of rejected alternative directions used to argue the chosen contrast is principled rather than lucky
differences.message_quote: a self-authored "keep in / keep out of mind" re-derivation, a "read for meaning vs read letter-by-letter" stance, a "what's this about vs what word comes next" stance, an anti-prior (FDR-style) direction, and a content direction — all fail or hurt; so does think-vs-secret.
differences.writeup_quote: a self-authored "keep in / keep out of your mind" re-derivation, a "read for meaning vs read letter-by-letter" stance, and a "what is this about vs what word comes next" stance all fail or hurt; so does contrasting think against the secret items.

rationale: Both documents identify the source as the white-bear-steering result by Raman et al. 2026, state that the submitted method reuses its mid-depth contrastive-stance-vector machinery and plain J-lens read-out, and claim the novelty lies in swapping the negative pole from the prior work's think/don't-think (secret) contrast to a think-vs-preference contrast, using a sub-family the earlier work explicitly excluded. The message additionally lists an \"anti-prior (FDR-style) direction\" and a generic \"content direction\" among the rejected alternatives used to justify this choice as principled, which the write-up does not mention, but this is a minor elaboration rather than a change in the stated relationship to, or novelty over, the source.
